text:
Lina (People Ops): quick, confidential request — an engineer asked for help coordinating a workspace move + schedule shift due to a neighboring desk causing frequent interruptions and sensory overload. tagging @Alex (their manager) to align on next steps.

Alex (Engineering Manager): thanks Lina. can you share whether they want a formal accommodation or just a short-term change? i can cover schedule adjustments for the team if needed.

Jamie (Senior Engineer): hi — this is Jamie. prefer to keep details private. i'm finding that sustained close conversations next to me (often loud) are breaking my focus and causing migraines. i can do async work but prefer to avoid 10:00–14:00 when the neighboring desk is busiest. would like a temporary desk move and to shift core hours earlier for 2–3 weeks while we try options. not asking for disability label right now, just practical help.

Lina (People Ops): understood. thanks for clarifying, Jamie. this is manageable. options: 1) temporary desk swap for 2 weeks, 2) early core hours (e.g., 8–12 core), 3) temporary noise-cancelling headset if desk move not available. we can treat this as a private accommodation request even if you don't want formal paperwork — but i recommend filling the short intake form so we have a record.

Alex (Engineering Manager): i can approve a desk swap and change to 8–4 core for Jamie temporarily. team will keep stand-up at 9 to avoid overlap. can people-ops coordinate desk availability?

people-ops-bot: case created: #2026-0457 (private). assigned to Priya. ETA: initial response within 1 business day. :white_check_mark:

Priya (People Ops): got it — i'll check floor seating and reach out to facilities. if desk swap is not immediately available, i'll book a quiet focus room for mornings and arrange a headset delivery. Jamie, would you like me to start the internal intake form on your behalf so there is a paper trail?

Jamie (Senior Engineer): yes please start the form, Priya. i appreciate the quiet room offer. can we keep this between people-ops and Alex for now?

Lina (People Ops): absolutely — we'll limit visibility. Priya, please cc only Alex and Lina on logistics.

Priya (People Ops): noted. next actions: - facilities check + propose desks (by EOD tomorrow) - book quiet room 8–12 for next 5 workdays if needed - initiate intake form and share link privately with Jamie - confirm schedule change in team calendar and update stand-up time.

Alex (Engineering Manager): thanks. i'll announce the stand-up time change and cover any async blockers.

Jamie (Senior Engineer): thank you all. small ask — can we review after 2 weeks to see if permanent change or further steps needed?

Lina (People Ops): yes, we'll schedule a check-in for 2 weeks after the swap. if symptoms persist, we can discuss formal reasonable adjustment options.

people-ops-bot: reminder scheduled: check-in with Jamie in 14 days.

Priya (People Ops): logging actions in case #2026-0457 and will DM the intake form to Jamie now. if anyone has objections to the limited visibility, please raise privately. otherwise i'll proceed. :seedling:
